name.ja: ＨＧ 1/144 ジム・ナイトシーカーＩＩ

description.ja: 高 速 の 狩 人 ―
description.en: Fast Hunter -

description.ja: 「機動戦士ガンダム Ｍｏｂｉｌｅ Ｓｕｉｔ Ｄｉｓｃｏｖｅｒｙ」より、
description.en: From "Mobile Suit Gundam Mobile Suit Discovery"

description.ja: ジム・ナイトシーカーIIがＨＧキットで商品化！肩部や足首、武装等の特徴的な箇所を新規造形で再現。
description.en: Jim Nightseeker II is commercialized with HGKit! Characteristic parts such as shoulders, ankles, and weapons are reproduced with new modeling.

description.ja: ●　ジム・ライトアーマーをベースに開発された、ジム・ナイトシーカーIIの特徴的な機体形状を新規造形を交えて再現。
description.en: ● The characteristic body shape of Jim Night Seeker II, which was developed based on Jim Light Armor, is reproduced with new modeling.

description.ja: 頭部、胸部、肩部、腰部、足首などの形状を新規造形で再現。
description.en: The shape of the head, chest, shoulders, waist, ankles, etc. is reproduced with new modeling.

description.ja: ・頭部
description.en: ·head

description.ja: 頭部バルカン砲をオミットした頭部パーツが新たに付属。
description.en: A new head part with the head Vulcan cannon removed is included.

description.ja: 差し替え式で指揮官機もしくは誘導機が装備する、マーカー・ポッド仕様の頭部を再現可能。
description.en: It is possible to reproduce the head of the marker pod specification that is equipped with a commander aircraft or guide aircraft by replacing it.

description.ja: ・胸部
description.en: ・Chest

description.ja: 胸部正面のパーツを新規造形で再現。
description.en: The front part of the chest is reproduced with new modeling.

description.ja: 特徴的な形状の胸部スラスターを再現。スラスターはボールジョイントでフレキシブルに可動。
description.en: Reproduce the distinctive shape of the chest thruster. The thruster can be moved flexibly with a ball joint.

description.ja: ・肩部
description.en: ・Shoulder area

description.ja: 軽量化された肩部アーマーを再現。幅広いポージングに対応。
description.en: Reproduce the lightweight shoulder armor. Compatible with a wide range of poses.

description.ja: ・腰部
description.en: ·waist

description.ja: パーツ構成が変更となったフロントアーマーが付属。
description.en: A front armor whose parts composition has been changed is included.

description.ja: ・足首
description.en: ·ankle

description.ja: アンクルガードが取り外されたパーツを新規造形で再現。
description.en: The parts with the ankle guard removed are reproduced with new modeling.

description.ja: ●　豊富なパーツが付属！
description.en: ● Comes with a variety of parts!

description.ja: グリップのデザインが異なるビーム・サーベルが新規で付属。
description.en: A new beam saber with a different grip design is included.

description.ja: 高出力のビーム・ガンやビーム・スプレーガンや100mmマシンガン等の豊富な武装を同梱。
description.en: Includes a wide range of armaments such as high-power beam guns, beam spray guns, and 100mm machine guns.

description.ja: ●　ラインマーク等を収録した新規デザインの専用マーキングシールが付属
description.en: ● Comes with a newly designed dedicated MarkingSeal that includes line marks, etc.

description.ja: 脚部のラインマーク、部隊マーク、各種コーションマークなどを収録した専用のマーキングシールが付属。
description.en: Comes with a special MarkingSeal that includes leg line marks, unit marks, various caution marks, etc.

description.ja: 付属武装：ビーム・ガン ／ 100mmマシンガン ／ ビーム・スプレーガン ／ ビーム・サーベル
description.en: Attached weapons: Beam gun / 100mm machine gun / Beam spray gun / Beam saber

description.ja: １／１４４スケール組み立て式プラモデル
description.en: 1/144 Scale Assembly plastic model

description.ja: 対象年齢：８才以上
description.en: Target age: 8 years old and above

description.ja: 製品素材：ＰＳ・ＰＥ
